label: preparing
what: A surprise tribute celebrating my forty years as mayor, disguised as a day 1 eighteen-hundred great-hall lighting inspection. Innkeeper arranges catering, Freight delivers bread, and Builder handles lighting and the timed invitation. Secretary knowingly maintains the appointment and has disclosed the surprise to me; Watchman knows of approved hospitality arrangements, though his knowledge of the tribute itself is uncertain. Freight reported 128 fresh loaves and eight lanterns in place, with 72 more loaves planned.
